answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Hardware attestation: each identity binds to one chip at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 260 identities costs 260 real chips plus the registration bond. The quote is fresh each cycle, so a stolen quote goes stale fast. The nebula test is the live device, the beacon test is the locked stake, and the grove test is the graded history no template can fake. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
